title: Metcalf denies trying to poke DeJean in eye; NFL won't suspend Steelers WR

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Metcalf denies trying to poke DeJean in eye; NFL won't suspend Steelers WR
sources.description: Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf on Monday denied trying to poke Eagles cornerback Cooper DeJean in the eye before he was ejected Sunday.
